extraction_notes: Multi-variant datasheet covering ES1AW through ES1JW (Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd, www.ichjc.com), superfast recovery rectifier in SOD-123FL; ES1JW column values used: VRRM=600V, VRMS=420V, VDC=600V, device marking code E7 (page 1).

Key maximum ratings (page 1): IF(AV)=1.0A at 60Hz sinewave resistance load per Fig.1, IFSM=30.0A at t=8.3ms half-sine, Tstg=-55 to +150degC, Tj=-55 to +150degC, typical RthJA=85degC/W and RthJL=35degC/W. Polarity: cathode line denotes cathode end.
VF table (page 2) at IF=1.0A splits by variant: 1.0V max (ES1AW-ES1DW), 1.3V max (ES1EW-ES1GW), 1.7V max (ES1JW); the ES1JW value is recorded.
Second reverse leakage spec not representable in the single reverse_current slot: IR2=200uA maximum at VR=VDC, Ta=125degC (page 2).
Trr=35ns maximum (IF=0.5A, IR=1.0A, Irr=0.25A) is a single family-wide table value on page 2.

No explicit breakdown voltage or breakdown test current is specified; Fig.4 (typical reverse characteristics) shows a sharp avalanche knee at approximately 124-126% of rated VRRM (about 745-755V for ES1JW), but this is a typical percent-of-rated curve, not a guaranteed spec, so breakdown fields are null.

Curves digitized pixel-wise from a 400 dpi rasterization of page 2 with axis calibration against labeled gridlines. Fig.3: the ES1JW-specific dashed curve was isolated from the two other variant-group curves; decade spacing below 1A is uniform, but the 1-20A top decade of the printed grid is irregular, so Fig.3 points above 1A carry roughly +/-0.03V extra uncertainty; below 1A reading uncertainty is about +/-0.015V. Fig.2 uncertainty about +/-0.5A; Fig.4 log-axis currents about +/-10%.
Fig.3 legend labels the middle curve ES1FW-ES1GW although the ratings tables list ES1EW/ES1GW columns and no ES1FW; this datasheet inconsistency does not affect the extracted ES1JW curve.

Fig.4 reverse-current curves apply family-wide as percent of rated VRRM; to convert to absolute volts for ES1JW multiply x-values by 6 (100% = 600V). The near-vertical breakdown region above 120% was not digitized because x-resolution there is unreliable.
Fig.1 derating and Fig.2 surge curves are family-wide (single curve for all variants); Fig.1 is flat at 1.0A up to 100degC lead temperature then derates linearly to about 0.2A at 151degC.
